pages.name: Morgan Vale
pages.summary: Operations Manager at Tidewater Ferry Authority; owns Larkspur LLCs; lives in Eastbrook.
pages.body:
- Operations Manager at Tidewater Ferry Authority. Also teaches the Saturday deckhand course at Marlow Maritime School (enrollment capped at twelve). Do not schedule calls before noon on Saturdays.
- Lives in Eastbrook. Spouse: Riley Vale. Children: Juno (b. March 9, 2012) and Felix (b. November 21, 2015). Mother: Anne Vale. Anniversary with Riley: June 14.
- Allergic to shellfish.
- Holding company: Larkspur Holdings LLC (owns Larkspur Cabins LLC and Larkspur Works LLC). Half owner of Quarry Road Partners LLC with Dana Okafor. DISPUTED: which entity holds Morgan's half of Quarry Road Partners. Ask Morgan which entity to name on any legal, tax or bank document.
- Accountant: Priya Shah at Shah & Lowe (was Leo Marsh until August 2026). Attorney: Tom Brandt, Brandt Law. Physician: Dr. Lena Ortiz, Eastbrook Family Practice. Umbrella policy with Keystone.
- 100-ton master license expires May 1, 2027; TWIC card expires August 30, 2028.
- Drives a 2019 Subaru Outback (was a 2015 Honda CR-V until June 2026). Dogs: Biscuit and Pepper.
- Signs formal documents "Morgan A. Vale", casual notes "Mo". Never use em dashes in anything public. Reports: 400 words max, answer first. Meeting notes as bullets with owner and date.
- Prefers aisle seats and morning flights for work. Gym: Harbor Athletic Club since October 2026. LLC records are in the shared drive folder Larkspur Records.

pages.name: Tidewater Ferry Authority
pages.summary: Ferry operator where Morgan is Operations Manager.
pages.body:
- Morgan is Operations Manager. Ines Calder is Harbor Master. Dana Reyes is Finance Director. Sam Whitlock is deputy operations manager since September 2026 (replaced Carla Mendez).
- Boats: MV Osprey (main route mornings), MV Tern (main route afternoons), MV Kestrel (spare).
- Weekly ops meeting is Tuesdays at 7:30 since October 2026.
- Terminal ticket office opens at 5:30 on weekdays. Fuel deliveries to the dock are Wednesdays. Winter schedule cuts the last weekday evening sailing.
- Morgan's terminal parking is spot A4 (was B12 before the lot was repaved).
- Coast Guard annual inspection for the MV Osprey is due February 12, 2027.
- Holiday on-call roster: sources disagree about who covers Christmas Day and New Year's Day (see Sam Whitlock).

pages.name: MV Osprey
pages.summary: Ferry on the main route in the mornings.
pages.body:
- Runs the main route in the mornings.
- Coast Guard annual inspection due February 12, 2027.

pages.name: MV Tern
pages.summary: Ferry on the main route in the afternoons.
pages.body:
- Runs the main route in the afternoons.
- Was out for an engine overhaul; returned to service November 3, 2026. The Kestrel covered afternoons meanwhile.

pages.name: MV Kestrel

pages.body:
- Tidewater's spare boat.
- Covered afternoons while the MV Tern was out for its overhaul.

- Heron Cabin hot tub coverage under the Alder Mutual policy is unresolved. Ask Morgan before telling anyone it is covered.

pages.name: Quarry Road Partners LLC
pages.summary: Rental-property LLC owned 50/50 by Morgan and Dana Okafor.
pages.body:
- Owned 50/50 by Morgan and Dana Okafor (confirmed).
- DISPUTED: which entity holds Morgan's half. The operating agreement says Larkspur Holdings LLC; the Granite Savings loan papers say Larkspur Cabins LLC. Ask Morgan which entity to name on any legal, tax or bank document.
- Owns 12 Quarry Road (bought 2019) and the duplex at 8 Alder Lane (bought 2022).
- Banks with Granite Savings. The Quarry Road refinance closed at 6.75% fixed for five years on $380,000 (an earlier commitment letter said 7.10%).
- Dana Okafor takes tenant calls. Eastbrook Heating & Oil services the boilers at both rentals and has a 24-hour line.

- Downstairs: Nell Park moved out October 15, 2026; the unit is vacant.
- Boiler serviced by Eastbrook Heating & Oil. Dana Okafor takes tenant calls.
- Disputed: which entity holds Morgan's half of the owner, Quarry Road Partners. Ask Morgan which entity to name on any legal, tax or bank document.

pages.name: Heron Cabin
pages.summary: Short-term rental in Pine Hollow, Vermont, owned by Larkspur Cabins LLC.
pages.body:
- Owned by Larkspur Cabins LLC. Listed through Staylark, whose host fee is 15% since October 1, 2026 (was 12%).
- Sleeps eight in three bedrooms. Check-in 4pm, check-out 10am. Base rate $285 a night since September 2026. Minimum stay two nights, three on holiday weekends, since September 2026 (was three nights).
- Internet: Greenline Fiber since May 2026 (was Pinecone Wireless). Hot tub: Summit Pools (was ClearSpa, which closed).
- Operating account moved to Northfield Credit Union in 2026 (was Granite Savings).
- Insured with Alder Mutual; policy renews January 15. Hot tub coverage is unresolved: the agent said yes by phone, the policy wording excludes it. Ask Morgan before telling anyone it is covered.
- Marisol Peña cleans ($165 per changeover). Hale Plumbing does plumbing. Dunmore Plowing plows the driveway. Firewood is delivered by the cord in October.
